proposal.description: PGOOD treats a qualifying count that has started (counter non-zero) as qualified, instead of one that has reached TARGET, which confuses 'qualifying' with 'qualified'
proposal.reason: In S_RUN with the comparator good, PGOOD now asserts on the first PWM falling edge rather than after PGOOD_DELAY_CYCLES consecutive good switching cycles. Any configuration with a delay above one cycle hands the load to the converter output almost at once.
